title: Bifrost privileged-operations audit — session re-verification on the exact installed binary
secrets: none (admin credentials and provider keys are env.<NAME> references; probe credentials are non-secret sentinels)

method.version: v2.2.3 (from install path; the binary exposes no -version flag)
method.isolation: disposable copy of the reference store under /tmp/opencode; CWD == app-dir; loopback-only; production service and /var/lib/company-os were never touched

r1_authentication_enforcement.chat_400_meaning: inference is NOT admin-gated (keyless request rejected on model, not 401)
r1_authentication_enforcement.meaning: Enabling auth enforces it on management READS and WRITES; /health stays open; inference stays available.

r2_additive_seed.input: disposable store (copy of reference) + config.json listing mistral + six providers + a provider absent from the store ('probeadd')
r2_additive_seed.pre_existing_provider_preserved: openai retained (present in store, absent from config.json)
r2_additive_seed.meaning: Startup reconciles config.json ADDITIVELY: it adds missing providers and never removes existing ones.

r3_seed_precedence.observation: the reference store's DB already held governance_config.is_auth_enabled='true'; a config.json with is_enabled:false did NOT override it (unauth GET returned 401)
r3_seed_precedence.meaning: config.json seeds a value only where the store lacks it. The live DB has no is_auth_enabled, so the auth seed WILL apply there.
